properties.name: tle.update.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable TLE updates from Space-Track.

properties.name: tle.update.cron
properties.description: Cron expression for scheduled TLE updates.

properties.name: tle.critical.update.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable critical satellite TLE updates.

properties.name: tle.critical.update.cron
properties.description: Cron expression for critical satellite TLE updates.

properties.name: tle.max-age-days
properties.description: Maximum TLE age in days for quality monitoring.

properties.name: tle.priority.norad.ids
properties.description: Comma-separated list of NORAD IDs to prioritise for TLE updates.

properties.name: spacetrack.username
properties.description: Space-Track API username for authentication.

properties.name: spacetrack.password
properties.description: Space-Track API password for authentication.

properties.name: spacetrack.base-url
properties.description: Space-Track API base URL.

properties.name: spacetrack.timeout.connect
properties.description: HTTP connection timeout for Space-Track API (seconds).

properties.name: spacetrack.timeout.read
properties.description: HTTP read timeout for Space-Track API (seconds).

properties.name: cdm.fetch.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable CDM ingestion from Space-Track.

properties.name: conjunction.analysis.enabled
properties.description: Enable or disable scheduled conjunction analysis.

properties.name: conjunction.analysis.cron
properties.description: Cron expression for scheduled conjunction analysis runs.

properties.name: conjunction.analysis.primary.norad.ids
properties.description: Comma-separated list of primary satellite NORAD IDs to analyse.

properties.name: conjunction.analysis.cooldown.minutes
properties.description: Minimum minutes between analysis runs for the same satellite.

properties.name: conjunction.cleanup.cron
properties.description: Cron expression for purging old conjunction events.

properties.name: conjunction.prediction.days
properties.description: Number of days ahead to propagate orbits when screening for conjunctions.

properties.name: conjunction.time.step.seconds
properties.description: Time step in seconds used during coarse orbit propagation.

properties.name: conjunction.min.distance.km
properties.description: Miss-distance threshold in km below which a close approach is recorded.

properties.name: conjunction.filter.altitude.tolerance.km
properties.description: Altitude band tolerance in km used to pre-filter candidate satellites.

properties.name: conjunction.filter.inclination.tolerance.deg
properties.description: Inclination tolerance in degrees used to pre-filter candidate satellites.

properties.name: conjunction.filter.raan.tolerance.deg
properties.description: RAAN tolerance in degrees used in the optional RAAN refinement filter.

properties.name: conjunction.filter.raan.enabled
properties.description: Enable the RAAN-based candidate refinement filter (skipped for polar orbits).

properties.name: conjunction.refinement.fine.step.seconds
properties.description: Fine time step in seconds for TCA refinement pass.

properties.name: conjunction.refinement.polish.step.seconds
properties.description: Polish time step in seconds for final TCA refinement pass.

properties.name: conjunction.refinement.threshold.km
properties.description: Miss-distance threshold in km that triggers the fine-step refinement pass.

properties.name: conjunction.refinement.window.seconds
properties.description: Time window in seconds around an initial close-approach point used for TCA refinement.

properties.name: conjunction.screening.batch.size
properties.description: Number of candidate satellites processed per screening batch.

properties.name: conjunction.screening.log.interval
properties.description: Log a progress message every N satellites during screening.

properties.name: conjunction.pc.combined.hbr.m
properties.description: Combined hard-body radius in metres used for Pc calculation.

properties.name: conjunction.pc.log.threshold
properties.description: Minimum Pc value above which a result is written to the log.

properties.name: conjunction.cdm.tca.window.hours
properties.description: Time window in hours within which a CDM TCA is matched to a TLE-screened conjunction.

properties.name: api.security.admin.username
properties.description: Username for the built-in ADMIN account.

properties.name: api.security.admin.password
properties.description: Password for the built-in ADMIN account. Load from an environment variable in production.

properties.name: api.security.operator.username
properties.description: Username for the built-in OPERATOR account.

properties.name: api.security.operator.password
properties.description: Password for the built-in OPERATOR account. Load from an environment variable in production.

properties.name: jwt.secret
properties.description: HMAC-SHA256 signing secret for JWT tokens. Must be at least 32 characters. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32.

properties.name: jwt.expiration-ms
properties.description: JWT token validity period in milliseconds.
